override._why: New Game opens NAME ENTRY for the family name (from about 49 s, やまだ filled in); A and Start only type kana, and confirming needs 決定 at the end of the bottom row and then はい on a prompt that defaults to いいえ. Each of the two name screens: A (on the second one the cursor starts in the mode column and A puts it on あ; on the first it just types), Down x6 to the bottom row, Left wraps to 決定, A, Left to はい, A. The story intro follows.
